note: These are trace dispositions for the first review of the earlier draft. The official stage run uses dispositions for the final current review, if that review reports canonical findings.

items.original_fact: Draft used unsupported accepted_risk confirm wording.
items.consequence: Unauthorized product direction could leak into spec.
items.next_action: Removed accepted_risk wording and restored generic user authorization/risk acceptance semantics.

items.original_fact: Draft reused RISK-001 with different semantics.
items.consequence: Risk ID traceability to decision-log was broken.
items.next_action: Renamed the spec-local independent-review risk to RISK-008.

items.original_fact: Dogfood observation contract lacked the five required elements.
items.consequence: Dogfood evidence could not be independently assessed.
items.next_action: Added FR-DIAG-003 and AC-DIAG-003 with stage, sample, independent observer, window, and judgment contract.

items.original_fact: All ACs omitted the nine-field close-readiness contract.
items.consequence: Close readiness could not be preflighted per AC.
items.next_action: Added nine-field contracts to all 23 in-scope ACs.
items.consumer: build-plan preflight and status/close read models

items.original_fact: DEFERRED-001 was reassigned to build-plan and alias convergence was not specified.
items.consequence: Carrier verification and control-plane registration could be lost.
items.next_action: Recorded build-spec compatibility comparison, selected a read-only preflight profile, and locked alias producer/consumer/removal semantics.

items.original_fact: AC labels used 通过条件/失败条件 and indentation instead of plain 通过/失败.
items.consequence: Template and checker semantics could diverge.
items.next_action: Changed all AC labels to plain line-starting 验证/通过/失败/证据.
items.evidence_ref: spec.md section 11 and local validator output

items.original_fact: Spec lacked the required head navigation section.
items.consequence: Draft-time navigation requirement was not demonstrated.
items.next_action: Added a regenerable non-authoritative 材料导航 section at the head of spec.md.

items.original_fact: Decision-log contains stale historical header/approval metadata.
items.consequence: A reader could mistake stale provenance for current approval state.
items.next_action: Do not rewrite the accepted decision-log during build-spec; the accepted step-11 record remains authoritative and spec.md now identifies the current downstream status contract.
items.evidence_ref: decision-log accepted step-11 record; spec.md section 8 status contract

items.original_fact: State and review cancellation semantics were scattered and incomplete.
